sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Add custom themes
Adds Custom color and Custom picture to Outlook's theme picker. Pick any color on a color wheel or any photo from the gallery.
Add unread shortcut
Adds an Unread shortcut to the Outlook icon that opens unread mail from every account.
Fix sign-in
Fixes signing in with Microsoft accounts.
GmsCore support
Signs in to Google accounts through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore.
Hide Copilot
Hides Copilot chat, summaries, scheduling and writing help on all accounts, regardless of the Copilot setting in Outlook.
Hide navigation buttons
Hides Calendar, Apps or the whole bottom bar. Choose which in the patches menu.
Keep messages unread
Leaves messages unread after opening them, or flagging or moving them from the reading pane.
Open email templates
Opens .oft template attachments as new drafts without a Microsoft 365 subscription.
Remove inbox ads
Removes sponsored messages from Focused and Other.
Select multiple search results
Long-press search results to select several, then mark, move or delete them together. Mail tab of search only.
